brand.name: Harbour & Pine Joinery
brand.tagline: Fitted joinery that looks like it was always there
brand.description: Made-to-measure wardrobes, shelving and kitchens in solid oak and tulipwood for older homes in Bristol and Bath.

design.thesis: Quiet, warm precision — a workshop that smells of cedar, shown with the restraint of good furniture.

sections.sub: Wardrobes, shelving and kitchens made to measure for awkward walls and older homes, built in our own workshop.

items.title: Fitted wardrobes
items.body: Built to the wall you have, sloping ceilings and uneven floors included.

items.title: Alcove shelving
items.body: Shelving and cupboards that frame a fireplace instead of fighting it.

pages.heading: What we make

items.title: Fitted wardrobes
items.body: Measured on site, drawn to scale and built to fit walls that are rarely straight.

items.title: Alcove shelving

pages.label: About
pages.title: About our workshop | Harbour & Pine Joinery
pages.description: Harbour & Pine designs, builds and fits bespoke joinery for older homes in Bristol and Bath, from first measure to final fitting by our own team.
pages.heading: The workshop

sections.headline: Designed, built and fitted by us
paragraphs: Every piece starts with a visit and a tape measure. We draw it, build it in our workshop and fit it ourselves, so the person who measured the wall is the person who answers for the result.

image.alt: Joiner planing an oak board in the workshop
image.brief: Hands planing a long oak board at the bench, shavings visible, warm workshop light.
